title: Teleport Block x Faithful 64x
body:
# A Faithful 64x styled texture pack for Teleport Block.

_This resource pack retextures the Teleport Block mod to better match the Faithful 64x visual style while preserving the original design and readability._

## Features:

Faithful 64x inspired textures
Improved visual consistency with Faithful packs
Mod-compatible texture replacements
Lightweight and easy to install

## Requirements:

Teleport Block mod
Matching Minecraft version

## Installation:

> Install Teleport Block.
> Place this resource pack into the resourcepacks folder.
> Enable it in Minecraft Resource Packs settings.
